consequence.statement: Configuration under `experimental.ruler.enable-api` will no longer be honored; the setting must be moved to `ruler.enable-api`.

original.statement: The `experimental.ruler.enable-api` configuration option is removed in Loki 3.0.0; users must migrate to `ruler.enable-api` instead.

decision.reason: [ev-8fea3a0e7308], in the upgrade guide section "Deprecated configuration options are removed", says `experimental.ruler.enable-api` is removed and to use `ruler.enable-api` instead. A removed config key means a configured value is no longer honoured, so setting-ignored (action) with remediation to move to `ruler.enable-api` fits. The evidence does not say startup fails, so a stronger failure kind is not supported. The severity ("high") is not stated in the evidence and is a judgement call, which is why confidence is low.
